name: Bloodmage: Blood Covenant pays its health cost and places its ritual object (#3996)
contract: #3996: 'not taking health, no rune, can't summon.' Blood Covenant 1200012 is a channeled ritual built like Ritual of Summoning 698: effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR (50) at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT summons gameobject 194111, a GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SUMMONING_RITUAL whose completion spell 1200014 places the meeting-stone rune 194114. Its cost is PowerType -2 (health) with ManaCostPercentage 90, which SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost takes from create health: 90% of the level-40 Bloodmage base health 704 (player_class_stats) = 633, paid by Spell::TakePower when the channel starts. Neither 194111 nor 194114 has a gameobject_template row in coa_world or in any SQL file, so Spell::EffectTransmitted logs the missing template and returns and nothing appears. Expected: the cast costs 633 health and places gameobject 194111 in front of the Bloodmage. The health assert passes on main; the object assert fails on main (count 0) and passes once the templates exist.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Blood Covenant takes 90% of base health (704 -> 633)
DISCRIMINATING: the Blood Covenant object stands in front of the Bloodmage
